0022600145.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-4) are 15th in the West and 5th in the Pacific, 3.5 games back, on a four-game losing streak, with a 0-2 road record. The New Orleans Pelicans (0-3) are 14th in the West and 5th in the Southwest, 3.5 games back, on a three-game skid. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), while New Orleans is without Yves Missi (knee bruise).
